In [[7 BBY]],<ref name="7 BBY">[[Salman Paak]] visited Jondora two [[Standard year|year]]s prior to the events of "[[Nobody's Listening!]]." The episode takes place about two months after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]]</ref> [[Salman Paak]] attended a Separatist meeting on the [[planet]] [[Jondora]] where he met a '''woman''' who told him that if he was serious about politics, he could act as a liaison when he returned to his homeworld. He was sent a fractal [[Subspace transceiver|radio]] unit and was paid to keep the radio alive.<ref name="Nobody's Listening!" />
